newsitem.title: USA: Jacksonville, Fla., sells naming rights to Alltel.
newsitem.headline: Jacksonville, Fla., sells naming rights to Alltel.

text.p: Florida's Jacksonville City Council unanimously aproved the sale of stadium naming rights to the Alltel Corp, the Times-Union reported Wednesday.

Under the deal with the city and the Jacksonville Jaguars, Alltel will pay $6.2 million over 10 years for the right to rename Jacksonville Municipal Stadium. The city will use the money for stadium upkeep.
Alltel is headquartered in Little Rock, Ark., and provides local phone services, cellular service and other communications products.
